relevant_sections: 2.4 Reference data for the accuracy assessment

required_promises.evidence: The method paper documents a slope maintained by grubbing and named freshly tilled epochs, including an immediately post-tillage reference on 2021-08-24. The exact sample bitstream has no publisher description, member inventory, event list, or selector binding any such epoch to this archive.

The data description says the general II_slope hierarchy has raw SLR/UAV imagery and processed dense clouds, precision maps and M3C2. It does not document which of those members or matching epochs are retained in 00_A_sample_slope.7z.

The method paper says at least one GCP was excluded as a CP, and the generic file description lists log/RMSE files. Neither source promises that this sample retains per-model GCP/CP role assignments or reproducible separate X/Y and Z CP residuals. Published aggregate or propagated point precision is not a substitute.

The method paper identifies TLS and UAV acquisitions on 2020-08-11, but the sample bitstream has no member description binding those surfaces to retained files or to a same-day time-lapse model. The generic slope inventory mentions processed UAV dense clouds but does not list a TLS product.

The data description promises filtered and unfiltered point clouds and describes removal of vegetation/non-soil elements, but no vegetation, object, water, snow, GCP, boundary, occlusion, interpolation, or visibility mask artifact. The method paper documents shadowing and contamination failure modes rather than a published mask product.

decision.reason: The exact 4.60 GB sample is not documented to contain the event binding, external-control artifacts, independent-reference identities, and masks required to justify a geometry download.
decision.supersedes: Any interpretation of replacement-target-selection-2.2026-07-14.json that treated generic full-dataset statements as promises about 00_A_sample_slope.7z.
decision.resume_condition: A publisher-side member manifest or updated official description must bind one named vegetation-free cultivated epoch to matching raw and processed geometry, per-model held-out CP roles with separate horizontal and vertical residuals, named same-epoch TLS/UAV references, and machine-usable exclusion and visibility masks. Only then may a new metadata audit consider a one-archive download ceiling.
